# Ecolates — Pure Sugarcane Bagasse Commercial Tableware & Food Packaging

> Ecolates is India’s premier manufacturer and exporter of 100% biodegradable and compostable sugarcane bagasse tableware, meal trays, food containers, bowls, and plates. Engineered from post-harvest residual sugarcane stalks (agro-waste), our products are zero-plastic, zero-tree-cut, microwave-safe (-20°C to 120°C), and decompose into organic soil compost within 90 days.

## Company Overview
- **Brand**: Ecolates Eco Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
- **Factory Location**: Agro Green Industrial Zone, Sanand, Gujarat, India
- **Production Capacity**: 20,000,000+ Units / Month across 18 high-speed hydraulic thermo-molding lines
- **Quality & Food Safety Certifications**: ISO 22000:2018 (Food Safety Management), ISO 9001:2015, BPI Certified Compostable, 100% PFAS-Free Lab Verified (<50 ppm total fluorine), FDA 21 CFR 176.170 compliant.
- **Thermal Performance**: Withstands -20°C deep freezing up to +120°C boiling hot oils and microwave reheating with zero sogginess or toxic leaching.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: Typically 1,000 to 2,000 pieces per master carton case.
- **Global Shipping**: Pan-India express dispatch (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai) and worldwide export containers.
